forbidden_patterns: hold the transaction open during the gateway

must_preserve: the current uniqueness check occurs too late to prevent duplicate capture attempts
requestId must reach the gateway as its idempotency key
database state needs an atomic claim or compare-and-set
recovery must reconcile capture success after a worker crash
tests include concurrent duplicates and crash recovery
must_avoid: an in-process mutex as the sole control
a database transaction spanning the external call
